name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
summary: Provides deposit-free LPG connections to eligible adult women from poor households, subject to the scheme conditions.
eligibility: Applicant must be an adult woman (18 years or older).
Applicant must belong to an eligible poor-household category/deprivation category listed by PMUY.
No other LPG connection should exist in the same household.
documents: Ration card or other state document establishing family composition (or prescribed migrant self-declaration)
Aadhaar of applicant and adult family members listed in family-composition proof
source_name: PMUY official FAQ, Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
notes: The official FAQ lists the eligible categories and required documents. Confirm the latest application instructions with the official portal or an LPG distributor. This app does not determine final approval.

name: e-Shram registration
summary: A national database and registration facility for eligible unorganised workers, intended to support access to welfare and social-security services.
eligibility: Worker should be engaged in unorganised work (for example, home-based, self-employed or wage work).
Official FAQ states that workers aged 16 years and above may register, subject to other prescribed criteria.
Official FAQ describes unorganised workers as workers who are not members of ESIC or EPFO.
documents: Aadhaar-linked mobile number; if unavailable, the official FAQ advises visiting a CSC/State Seva Kendra for biometric registration
source_name: e-Shram official FAQ, Ministry of Labour & Employment
notes: The portal is a worker-registration database; registration itself should not be represented as automatic approval for every linked welfare benefit. Check the portal for current criteria and processes.

name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan (PM-SYM)
summary: A voluntary contributory pension scheme for eligible unorganised workers, with an assured monthly pension described on the official e-Shram scheme page.
eligibility: Indian citizen working in the unorganised sector.
Must not be a member of EPFO, ESIC or NPS (government-funded), as stated on the official scheme page.
documents: Aadhaar and other documents requested by the official enrolment channel
source_name: e-Shram official scheme page, Ministry of Labour & Employment
notes: This is a contributory pension scheme; contribution amounts depend on entry age. Confirm current enrolment rules and contribution details through the official portal/CSC.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
summary: A financial-inclusion programme enabling an unbanked person to open a basic savings bank deposit account and access listed banking services.
eligibility: The official scheme page describes opening a basic savings bank deposit account for a person who does not have another bank account.
Account opening is available through a bank branch or Bank Mitra outlet, subject to bank/KYC requirements.
documents: KYC documents accepted by the bank; confirm the current list with the bank or official PMJDY portal
source_name: PMJDY scheme details, Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
notes: The page lists benefits including no minimum-balance requirement for PMJDY accounts. Specific insurance and overdraft benefits have conditions; do not assume every account holder automatically qualifies.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
summary: An income-support scheme for eligible landholding farmer families, subject to the scheme's exclusion criteria and verification through state land records.
eligibility: The operational guidelines describe eligible landholding farmer families, with benefits subject to specified exclusion categories.
Landholding details are checked using state/UT land records and scheme verification processes.
Certain institutional landholders and specified higher-income/professional categories are excluded under the guidelines.
documents: Aadhaar and bank details as required by the official portal and current registration process
source_name: PM-KISAN official portal and operational guidelines, Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
notes: Do not use this short summary as a final eligibility decision. The official guidelines contain detailed exclusion rules; check the portal and the relevant state land records.
